name: Mimi x Mimi! ~Hatsujou Chuuihou~
source:
Girls suddenly acquired different beast ears. And somehow their behavior also becomes animal-like. It's so irresistible! Miya gets cat habits, Natsuki - dog ones. Will peaceful days ever return?
